text.p: Questron Technology Inc said Tuesday it approved a one-for-10 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common stock, adding the split should be effective within the next week.
The company currently has 15,354,842 shares outstanding. After the reverse split, there will be 1,535,484 shares outstanding.

Questron said in a release that shareholders, at an annual meeting last week, also reelected Milton Adler, Robert Gubitosi, Mitchell Hymowitz, William McSherry, and Dominic Polimeni to its board of directors for another year.

In addition, shareholders approved a decrease in the number of shares of common stock authorized to be issued by the company to 20 million from 50 million, but rejected a proposal to decrease the number of shares of preferred stock authorized to be issued by the company to 6 million from 10 million.
